arStrings.szText: You've acquired a piece of {c_unique}Chaos Armor{/c} — warped by demonic influence, its power is stronger than other Unique Items.
{c_unique}Chaos Unique Items{/c} ignore typical loot rules. They can drop in any Armor slot: helm, chest, gloves, pants, or boots.
Discover more {c_gambling}Chaos Armor{/c} by defeating {c_highllight}Bartuc, Lord of Chaos{/c}in {icon:Icon_Chaos_Wave,2.}{c_highlight}Infernal Hordes{/c}.
